blockers: No functional signup, dashboard, subscription, or checkout route was exposed; Sign in, Dashboard, and Start generating all link back to /docs.
The OpenAPI specification documents image generation only—no account-provisioning, billing, checkout, payment, or x402 endpoint.
Payment is described only as monthly card billing through an unspecified human-oriented dashboard.
Absence of CAPTCHA, KYC, email confirmation, or another human gate could not be verified because no purchase flow exists.
Overage pricing is referenced but the per-generation rates are not disclosed.
trust_events: The domain was registered on 2026-07-20 and its certificate began 2026-07-21, but the terms and privacy policies claim an effective date of 2026-06-01.
The claimed operator, Driftflight Studio, Inc., lacks a stated jurisdiction, physical address, registration number, or independently corroborated public presence.
The advertised legal@ and privacy@ addresses use a domain with no MX record, making the contact channels doubtful.
Customer names and testimonials could not be independently corroborated.

The polished marketing site and public read-only API endpoints exist, but the complete absence of account and payment infrastructure warrants warning that the offering may be unfinished or illegitimate.
notes: Primary service: Driftflight text-to-image API subscriptions. Pricing: Hobby $5/month for 100 generations, 1024px sketch tier, shared presets, personal license; Studio $29/month for 750 generations, sketch and 2048px studio tiers, commercial license plus C2PA, 3 seats; Agency $119/month for 3,000 generations, all tiers through 4096px gallery, private presets, priority processing, unlimited seats and SSO. Billing is monthly in advance; annual billing claims a 20% discount; completed defective renders may be refunded on request within 30 days; generated URLs persist 90 days. Public evidence: [pricing](https://drift-flight.org/pricing), [API documentation](https://drift-flight.org/docs), [OpenAPI specification](https://api.drift-flight.org/openapi.json), [terms](https://drift-flight.org/terms), and [privacy policy](https://drift-flight.org/privacy). End-to-end agent purchase is not currently possible.
